name: pr-review
description: Three reviewers look at the same change in parallel (security, performance, readability) and a summary decides: ok or changes-requested.

stages.name: Security
stages.promptTemplate: Review the change for security problems. Task: {task}

stages.name: Performance
stages.promptTemplate: Review the change for performance problems. Task: {task}

stages.name: Style & readability
stages.promptTemplate: Review the change for readability and style. Task: {task}

stages.name: Summary
stages.promptTemplate:
Summarize the three reviews for: {task}

List what must change before merging. Answer with an outcome: ok when nothing blocks the merge, changes-requested otherwise.
